articles.title_zh: What we know about the ground stop and what to do if you're affected
facts_zh:
What we know about the US ground stop and what to do if your flight is affected
- Published
The US Federal Aviation Administration has lifted the longest nationwide ground stop of flights since the 11 September 2001 attacks.
The FAA said Friday's stoppage, which lasted more than four hours, was "due to extraordinary circumstances" from a communication issue affecting all air traffic control centres.
Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there was no indication of a cyber-attack and that everybody was safe.

articles.title_original: Choking fires, deadly heat and devastating floods: 2026 in extreme weather
articles.title_zh: Choking fires, deadly heat and devastating floods: 2026 in extreme weather
facts_zh: People around the world have contended with unprecedented weather events and their fatal effects caused by the climate catastrophe After the world’s hottest summer since records began in 1850, the death toll from extreme weather in 2026 is already in the high tens of thousands.
That is a conservative estimate and is certain to rise much higher.

As Cop31 continues and scientists warn that climate breakdown may be accelerating , the Guardian looks back at a year of droughts, fires and floods as a reminder that, unless the world takes urgent action to cut emissions, this disastrous year will be one of the best of the rest of our lives.

articles.title_zh: Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage
facts_zh:
Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage
- Published
Microsoft has said its services have been fully restored after a worldwide outage affected several of its tools, causing disruption.
The tech firm said early on Saturday morning that efforts to address the underlying problem had been completed and customers using Outlook, Teams and Copilot should no longer be affected.
The outage hit more than 70 countries, disrupting everything from business operations to government services and personal users.
